trigger: Creation-to-final-notification > observed P90 (23.927 min); descriptive case-review cutoff
action: Instrument first dispatch and reassignment; review high-delay orders before testing an escalation workflow.
controllability: Moderate: operational escalation can be tested; missing assignment history limits diagnosis.
monitoring_kpi: P90 creation-to-final-notification, late >5min, completion, recorded cost per reviewed order
trade_off: Premature escalation and manual review add effort; validate a small pilot.
confidence: Supported descriptive cohort; intervention effect untested
ordering_rule: Supported cohorts first, then observed late>5min order burden descending, then order frequency. Controllability is qualitative; cohorts overlap and burdens must not be summed.

issue: High within-clock demand with low observed supply
trigger: Within-clock high-demand / low-observed-supply tertile cell; descriptive combination
action: Audit supply coverage and order mix before piloting a schedule adjustment in repeated problem windows.
controllability: Conditional: schedules can change, but actual capacity and coverage must be verified first.
monitoring_kpi: Supply coverage, pressure proxy, service P95, late >5min, completion
trade_off: More scheduled hours can reduce throughput per observed hour; no savings are assumed.
confidence: Supported descriptive cohort; intervention effect untested
ordering_rule: Supported cohorts first, then observed late>5min order burden descending, then order frequency. Controllability is qualitative; cohorts overlap and burdens must not be summed.

trigger: An order falls in an hour without observed supply
action: Repair missing shift observations and monitor join coverage before interpreting capacity metrics.
controllability: High for data capture; missing observation does not mean no riders.
monitoring_kpi: Observed-supply coverage of order hours and orders
trade_off: Capture quality is an enabling investment with unquantified financial benefit.
